Questions people actually ask

Are Supplier Pro and Buyer Pro for the same business?
No. They're for different businesses. When you sign up, you pick whether you sell (supplier, distributor) or buy (store, restaurant, contractor). You only ever see and pay for the Pro for your side. Business is the same Pro, for bigger teams.
What stays free?
Chat, orders, order links, payment tracking, who owes you, your online store and unlimited partners. Forever.
Is Pro really free right now?
Yes. During the pilot, every Pro feature is on for everyone. You'll hear from us well before that changes, and anyone who pays early keeps the founding price.
Do my suppliers or buyers have to sign up?
No. Send an order as a link on Viber, Messenger or text. They open it in their browser and confirm. No app, no account. If they join later, their past orders are waiting.
Do I have to use routes or the cheque tracker?
No. They're optional. Orders and payments work the same without them, and you can hide Routes from your menu.
Does Nifti handle our money?
No. You pay each other directly through GCash, Maya, bank or cash, like today. Nifti keeps the record, and the other side confirms it arrived. Pro is paid by GCash or bank transfer.
Can my competitors see my prices or who I buy from?
No. Orders and prices are private to you and each partner. Only what you put on your store or Discover profile is public, and that's your choice.
Can I leave anytime?
Yes. There's no contract. Download all your data or delete your account from Settings.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 22, 2026 · Effective for pilot use of Nifti

This describes what Nifti actually does today, for a small pilot. It is written to be accurate about how your data is really handled. Nothing here is legal advice.

What data we collect

  • Account & business information — your name, email, business name and type (buyer/supplier), and the team members you invite.
  • Business records — purchase orders, inventory and stock levels, supplier/buyer relationships, standing price agreements, and messages exchanged with counterparties on the platform.
  • Payment information — Nifti does not process payments or hold funds. Buyers pay suppliers directly (GCash, Maya, bank transfer, etc.). We store the payment account details a supplier chooses to show their connected buyers, and the payment records you enter (method, amount, reference number, optional receipt photo). We never ask for or store passwords, PINs, or card numbers.
  • Usage data — basic technical data (browser type, general error logs) to keep the app working correctly.

Where it's stored

Your data is stored in a Supabase-hosted PostgreSQL database, transmitted over encrypted HTTPS connections. Access to your business's data is enforced at the database level (row-level security) — a business can only ever read or write its own records, or records a counterparty has explicitly shared with it (e.g. a purchase order between a specific buyer and supplier). Team members within your business see only what their assigned role permits.

Who we share data with

  • Supabase — our database and authentication infrastructure provider.
  • Your counterparties — a supplier you send a PO to sees that order's details; a buyer you're connected to sees the pricing and catalog you've shared with them. Nothing is visible to a business you haven't connected with.

We do not sell your data, and we do not share it with anyone outside the above without your consent or a legal requirement to do so.

Your rights

You can access, correct, or delete your business's data at any time from within the app, or by contacting us at ty.sigmund@gmail.com. If you close your account, we'll remove your data within a reasonable period, except where we're required to retain records (e.g. for financial/tax purposes).

Security — what's actually built

Role-based permissions enforced at the point of every action, not just by hiding a button; an audit log recording who changed what, including denied attempts; row-level security so no business can query another's data even through a bug in the app itself.

What this pilot does not yet have: a formal security audit, penetration testing, or SOC 2/ISO 27001 certification. Reasonable, but not enterprise-grade — appropriate for a small trusted pilot, not yet for handling sensitive data at scale.

Changes to this policy

We'll update this page as the product changes, and let pilot users know of any material change directly.

Contact

Questions about this policy or your data: ty.sigmund@gmail.com.

Last updated: September 22, 2026 · Effective for pilot use of Nifti

These terms cover pilot use of Nifti. Nifti never holds or moves your money: buyers pay suppliers directly, and Nifti only records what each side says was paid and confirmed. Nothing here is legal advice.

1. Acceptance of terms

By creating an account or using Nifti, you agree to these terms. If you're using Nifti on behalf of a business, you're confirming you have the authority to bind that business to these terms.

2. What Nifti is

Nifti is a procurement platform connecting buyers and suppliers — purchase orders, inventory tracking, messaging, price agreements, and payment processing. This is a pilot version: expect bugs, and treat it as a tool you're helping test, not a finished, guaranteed-stable product.

3. Accounts

You're responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide and for keeping your login credentials secure. Team members you invite act on your business's behalf according to the role you assign them.

4. Suppliers & buyers, pricing

Suppliers use Nifti at no cost. Buyer accounts may be on a free trial or paid plan as shown in Settings → Billing. Data is never deleted on downgrade — you keep access to your own historical records regardless of plan.

5. Acceptable use

You agree not to use Nifti to commit fraud, misrepresent a business relationship, access data outside your assigned role, or interfere with the platform's normal operation.

6. Payments

Nifti is not a payment processor and never holds, receives, or transfers money. Buyers pay suppliers directly through their own GCash, Maya, bank, or other accounts. Nifti only records what each business reports: a buyer submits a payment with its reference number, and it counts as paid only after the supplier confirms it arrived. Suppliers are responsible for keeping their listed payment details accurate. Buyers should confirm any recently changed payment details directly with the supplier before sending money. Disputes about a specific payment are between the buyer and supplier, and may also be subject to the terms of the e-wallet or bank used.

7. Your data

Your business's records (orders, pricing, inventory, messages) remain yours. Nifti's role is to host and process it on your behalf, not to claim ownership of it.

8. Disclaimer & limitation of liability

Nifti is provided "as is" during this pilot, without warranty of uninterrupted or error-free operation. To the fullest extent permitted by law, Nifti's liability for any claim arising from your use of the platform is limited to the amount you've paid us in the preceding 3 months (or ₱0 if you're on a free/trial plan).

9. Termination

You can stop using Nifti and close your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate an account for a clear violation of section 5 (Acceptable use).

10. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of the Philippines.

11. Changes

We'll notify pilot users directly of any material change to these terms.

Contact

Questions about these terms: ty.sigmund@gmail.com.

Help & Support

How do I invite a new supplier?
Go to Orders or the sidebar's Invite page — it takes under 5 minutes and they don't need to install anything.
A supplier hasn't confirmed my order — what now?
Message them directly from the order — every message is tied to the order it's about.
Something's gone wrong with an order or payment
Open the order and message the other party directly — every message is tied to the order it's about, so there's no need to explain the context again.
Is the platform up right now?
Check system status →

Your business

🏪 Business profile

Shown to suppliers you invite or connect with.
DC
No photo? We'll show your initials, like now.

💳 How buyers pay you

Buyers see these accounts when they pay your invoices and deposits. They pay you directly, and Nifti never holds or touches the money. You confirm each payment once you see it in your own account. Only an Owner or General Manager can change these.

🧾 Tax & BIR registration

Printed onto your Sales Invoices and Delivery Receipts. Nifti doesn't verify any of this with BIR — it's your responsibility to make sure your Authority to Print or CAS accreditation is valid and that you're permitted to issue computerized invoices.

📅 Upcoming BIR filing

Calculated from a fixed BIR deadline rule (25 days after quarter-end) and your Sales Invoices on file — not a guarantee of what you'll actually owe once your accountant applies input tax credits.

📞 Your contact for partners

Shown on the order and delivery links you send, so suppliers and drivers know who to call and where to go.

🚚 Delivery partners

Drivers, riders and couriers you use. From any confirmed order, tap "Send to a delivery partner" to give them a link with the items and address (no prices). They tap Picked up and Delivered, and you both get notified.

Privacy & data

🔒 Privacy & discoverability

Controls who can find you and what they can see.
Let other businesses find me in Discover
Off by default. Shows your name, the short profile you write and, for suppliers, your product list. Never your orders or who you work with.
🔒 Your suppliers and buyers stay private
Nobody else on Nifti can see who you work with, what you pay, or your orders. This is always on.

👀 View-only access for your accountant

Give your bookkeeper, accountant or business partner a link to see your orders and payments. They can't change anything and don't need an account. You can turn a link off anytime.

🕵️ Activity log

Price overrides, stock changes, cancelled orders and approvals: who did what, and when.

🔐 Your data

Everything Nifti holds about your business is yours. The spreadsheets open in Excel or Google Sheets.
Deleting removes your business, team logins, catalog and store. Partners you traded with keep their own copy of shared orders, shown as "Deleted business".

📧 Email sending (only you see this)

Nifti sends password resets, email alerts, morning summaries and Help messages from a Gmail account. Free, about 500 emails a day. One-time setup, about 2 minutes.

🗄 Backups (only you see this)

A full copy of everything in Nifti is saved every Sunday at 2am, and the last 10 are kept. Download one now and then to keep a copy outside Nifti too (laptop or Google Drive).
